about.heroH1:
I'm not a consultant who talks about marketing.
I'm the person who does it.
about.heroSub: 28 years. Three continents. From interactive agencies in São Paulo to holding-company shops in London and Miami to building my own boutique — and now operating at the fractional C-suite level.
about.bgP1: Brazilian-born. Miami-based. Two years living and working in the UK. I bring a genuinely multicultural lens to brand strategy — which is exactly why clients hire me to navigate the cultural complexity of entering the US market.
about.bgP2: My career spans the full arc of modern marketing — from digital's earliest days at Isobar to holding-company creative direction at Y&R, to building a boutique agency that served major Brazilian and Latin American brands entering the US.
about.bgP3: Today I operate as a Fractional CMO through Chameleon Collective — an elite network of independent practitioners who embed directly into client organizations to lead transformation from the inside.
about.bgQuote: I don't advise from the outside. I lead from the inside. Every engagement I take, I'm a genuine member of the client's leadership team — accountable to the same results they are.
about.timelineH2: A track record built across the world's most demanding markets.

intelligence.productsH2: Six ways I turn data into competitive advantage.

products.headline: Decision-grade market entry intelligence for international brands.
products.title: International Expansion Viability Report
products.sub: Proprietary CVE Score, competitive landscape, regulatory snapshot, distribution channel map, three strategic paths, and a 12-month roadmap. 100+ pages, white-labeled, in 14 days.
deliverables: CVE — Expansion Viability Coefficient: probability of success in the new market combining real-world data, AI analysis, and local expertise
Clear investment estimates: cost projections for marketing, operations, and e-commerce
Strategic timeline: step-by-step action plan from product adaptation to launch campaign
Competitor map: key players, competitive differentials, and white-space opportunities
Detailed viability report (100+ pages) + executive video presentation with Q&A

products.headline: Know if your idea has a market before you spend a dollar building it.
products.title: Idea Validation Analysis
products.sub: Fill out a 10-minute form describing your idea. Soundcheck's AI runs independent market research, analyzes the competition, sizes the opportunity, and estimates what your target customer would pay. You receive a full analysis and a one-page Summary Card in 48 hours.
deliverables: Market Demand Signals: real search volume, consumer interest data, and category trend analysis
Competitive Gap Analysis: who's already doing this, how well, and exactly where white space exists
Target Customer Profile: demographics, behaviors, and willingness-to-pay signals
Go / No-Go Recommendation: conditions for success, risk factors, and Year 1–3 revenue potential
Full analysis report + one-page Summary Card

products.headline: A complete, research-backed business plan built for investor conversations, lender requirements, and operational clarity.
products.title: Business Plan Development
products.sub: A complete, research-backed business plan for companies in setup or pre-launch — built for investor conversations, lender requirements, and operational clarity.
deliverables: Market Analysis & Customer Personas: category size, growth drivers, and detailed buyer profiles based on real data — not assumptions
Competitive Landscape & Positioning: direct competitor mapping, differentiation strategy, and the positioning that makes your brand impossible to ignore
Go-To-Market Strategy: channel priorities, launch sequencing, and acquisition strategy designed for your specific market and budget
Revenue Projections (3-Year): conservative, base, and optimistic scenarios with clear assumptions — the financial model investors actually trust
In-depth report + executive presentation & Q&A session

products.headline: Test creative concepts, product ideas, pricing, and positioning with AI-generated personas that mirror your target audience.
products.title: AI Virtual Focus Groups
products.sub: Test creative concepts, product ideas, pricing, and positioning with AI-generated personas that mirror your target audience. No recruiting. No scheduling. Delivered in days.
deliverables: Custom AI Personas: 3–10 personas built from exact target demographics — age, income, lifestyle, purchase behavior — mirroring your real audience
Moderated Discussion Transcript: structured, bias-free — every persona responds independently, no groupthink or dominant voices
Executive Summary & Recommendations: key findings distilled into clear strategic recommendations for your team
Reusable Persona Panel: saved and available for future sessions — test new concepts, packaging, or messaging anytime

products.headline: Know which companies deserve your team's time before you spend it.
products.title: Funding Vetting Analysis
products.sub: Two structured interviews — one with the founder team, one with a real customer. Soundcheck runs independent research, surfaces contradictions between both interviews, and delivers a one-page ADVANCE / CONDITIONAL / STOP verdict with the evidence behind it.
deliverables: Two structured interviews: one with the founder team, one with a real customer
Independent research: market validation, competitive positioning, and risk assessment
Contradiction analysis: surfaces gaps between founder narrative and customer reality
One-page ADVANCE / CONDITIONAL / STOP verdict with supporting evidence
Full analysis report with deal-breaker conditions and risk factors

products.sub: I assess your marketing organization across Strategy, Team, and Execution to identify growth blockers, uncover capability gaps, and prioritize the highest-leverage opportunities for improvement.
deliverables: Stakeholder interviews across leadership, marketing, sales, and operations
Scored assessment across Strategy, Team, and Execution dimensions
Growth blocker identification with root cause analysis
Prioritized recommendations with sequencing and resource implications
Executive presentation with a clear roadmap to unlock growth

intelligence.whySub: Too many companies enter new markets on gut feeling, anecdotal research, or outdated reports. Soundcheck changes that — without the agency price tag or the 6-month timeline.

whyItems.title: Data-Backed Decisions
whyItems.desc: Every recommendation is supported by real market data — competitor analysis, consumer behavior, distribution landscape, regulatory requirements.

whyItems.title: Expert-Validated Output
whyItems.desc: AI does the aggregation. I apply 28 years of cross-cultural marketing experience to validate, contextualize, and translate findings into strategy.

whyItems.title: Fast and Affordable
whyItems.desc: Traditional market research firms charge $30,000–$80,000 and take 3–6 months. Soundcheck delivers equivalent depth in 7–14 days at a fraction of the cost.

whyItems.title: Standalone or Integrated
whyItems.desc: Start with an intelligence engagement, then move into a full fractional CMO relationship — or use the output to brief another agency. Your choice.
